    # Split content by the processing blocks: [*] [index/total] Processando:
    blocks = re.split(r'\[\*\]\s+\[\d+/\d+\]\s+Processando:\s+', content)
    
    errors = []
    
    # The first block is header/empty, so skip it
    for block in blocks[1:]:
        lines = block.splitlines()
        if not lines:
            continue
            
        title = lines[0].strip()
        url = None
        has_error = False
        
        for line in lines[1:]:
            line_strip = line.strip()
            if line_strip.startswith("URL:"):
                url = line_strip[4:].strip()
            elif line_strip.startswith("[-] Acesso negado") or line_strip.startswith("[-] Erro ao carregar"):
                has_error = True
                
        if has_error and title and url:
            errors.append((title, url))
            
    print(f"[+] Total de erros identificados: {len(errors)}")
    
    with open(output_file_path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f_out:
        f_out.write("# ==============================================================================\n")
        f_out.write("# IMC PACKS DOWNLOADER - APENAS OS ERROS DE DOWNLOAD\n")
        f_out.write("# ==============================================================================\n")
        for title, url in errors:
            f_out.write(f"[x] {title} | {url}\n")
            
    print(f"[+] Arquivo '{output_file_path}' gerado com os {len(errors)} itens com erro.")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
